name: Stage Performance Attribution Coupling 01

tooling_note.before_exposure: The original probe relied on --remote-debugging-port=0 and DevToolsActivePort; EdgeCore launched a child browser but its launcher exited before writing that file.
tooling_note.correction: Probe discovery was changed to a caller-supplied explicit localhost CDP port and Browser.close cleanup only. No method value, harness byte, family geometry, copy, falsifier or scoring rule changed.

CINC.finding: Detached incumbent panel preserves the existing hierarchy but leaves spatial source attribution weak by design.

CNEG.finding: Centered detached panel keeps source attribution text-only and therefore does not improve the bounded spatial relationship.

F1.name: Source-Aligned Dock
F1.strength: Source ownership becomes immediately obvious across edge and noncentral source positions.
failures: Moving the whole dominant region toward the source makes the Performance read too much like a source-owned/private Character card rather than a shared Stage occurrence.
At 320px the 62% dock materially compresses the Performance text/history region and overweights source ownership relative to ensemble Stage context.

F2.name: Source-Aligned Header
F2.strength: The global Performance region remains fixed while the explicit source header tracks the source Character locus, improving attribution with no connector ornament and preserving the dominant Performance plus secondary-history hierarchy.
F2.falsifier_result: PASS across wide, 320px and forced-colors fallback; attribution remains textually explicit and spatially reinforced without chat-tail, causal-arrow, selected-control or transcript-rail implication.

F3.name: Floor Witness Line
F3.strength: The source-to-panel relationship is immediately legible.
failures: The vertical witness reads too much like a speech tail/callout connector and risks causal-direction meaning between Character and Performance region.
The extra reaching ornament competes with the quiet Character/floor carrier more than necessary.

F4.name: Source Edge Aperture
F4.strength: Keeps the global panel fixed and avoids a reaching connector.
failures: The edge opening is too subtle to make source attribution immediately clearer than the detached control across all source positions.
The broken panel edge can read as a selected tab/inspector attachment rather than Performance attribution.

decision.reason: F2 is the only candidate that materially improves source attribution while preserving the dominant Performance as shared Stage occurrence and adding the least structural ornament.

next_action.action: After guarded PERF-S1 method/result promotion and serial closeout, open one separately frozen exact-incumbent Stage comparison using F2 Source-Aligned Header as the only attribution-coupling challenger.
next_action.same_step_prohibition: Do not construct or score a full Stage F2 challenger inside this method/matrix result gate.

incumbent dominant Performance copy and recent-history content
Character/cone positions, state semantics, palette, background, right rail and creator actions
no Beat/history-density, Archive-causality, consequence, motion or runtime-semantic change

result: SELECT F2 — Source-Aligned Header as the sole provisional PERF-S1 survivor. PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 remains authoritative pending a separately frozen exact-incumbent Stage comparison. APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
